title: DAC12 DMA 采样时间发生器
description: DAC12 sends a repetitive signal using DMA and sample timer generator. The sample timer generator is configured to 1MSPS, so the output frequency will be 1MSPS / (Number of samples). The sine-wave contains 64 samples, resulting in 15.625kHz. The DAC is configured to use VDDA/VSSA as reference.（SDK 例程：dac12_dma_sampletimegen）
